title: POST /v1/recovery/finish request
description: Body of POST /v1/recovery/finish (03-api.md section 4.1). With `agent` (an account without an active passkey, KOR-62, 11-agent-access.md section 5.5): `proof` is the identity's signature over P||'agent-recover\0'||canonical({agent,agent_pub,challenge,method,user}) and the agent becomes the main orchestrator.

agent.description: the new main orchestrator of a recovery without a passkey (KOR-62)

bundle_ct.description: the user's identity sealed to the agent under a handover secret the agent drew itself (11-agent-access.md section 3, agent-bundle); at least 48 bytes

label_ct.description: the label {host,name} sealed to the user's identity (agent-label); at least 48 bytes

method.description: the proof-of-possession method (today one value; 11-agent-access.md section 3)
